intro: Perched on a ridge in the southwestern Eastern Plaguelands, the Marris Stead was once a peaceful Lordaeron homestead. Following the devastation of the Third War, it now serves as the lonely, heavily defended redoubt of Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Forsaken.
